To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mutagenic pyrolisates of amino acids and soybean protein were found to be weak skin tumor initiators in the two-stage mouse skin carcinogenesis model.
Trp-P- 2, Trp-P-l, MeA alphaC and Phe-P-l were tumour initiators in a two-stage carcinogenesis model.
Trp-P- 1, Trp- P-2, Me A alpha C, A a C, Glu- P-1, Gl u- P- 2, Lys- P- 1, IQ and Ph e- P-1 were found to be tumour initiators in a two-stage carcinogenesis model using the mouse skin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of carcinogens and mutagens in food.
the carcinogenicity of mutagenic pyrolized amino acids and related compounds.
the identification of the carcinogens in the food, the evaluation of their tumour initiating activity and the elucidation of the mechanisms involved in the process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the mutagenic pyrrolizidine alkaloids MeA alpha C (ID50: 2.5 mg) and A alpha C (ID 50: 4.2 mg), and the mutagenic amino acid pyrolysates Trp-P- 1 (ID50:1.0 mg), Trp-P-3 (ID50:2.0 mg) and Phe-P (ID50:20 mg) were active as tumour initiators, whereas

the mutagenic pyrollysates of amino acid and proteinaceous food, Trp-P2, Trp-P1, MeAalphaC, AalphaC, Glu-P1, Glu-2, Lyp-P1, IQ and Ph-P1 are tumour initiators in the two-stage mouse skin carcinogenesis model, but the degree of activity is different for each compound.
Trp-P- 2, Trp-P1, MeAalphaC and Phe-P1 are tumour initiators, and that IQ and Lys-P1 are weak tumour initiators in this two-stage skin tumour model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tumour-initiating activity of the pyrolysates tested is not necessarily related to the mutagenicity in the Ames test.
the tumour initiating activity was found to be in the order of Trp-P- 2 = MeA alpha C > Trp-P-3 > Trp-P1 > A alpha C > Phe-P- 1 > IQ > Lys-P- 1 = Glu-P- 2 > Glu-P- -1.
the mutagenicity of the compounds tested is not always correlated with their tumour-initiating activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ID50 values of the compounds tested in our study are in the same range as the values reported for the other known tumour initiators.
the ID50 values for Trp-P compounds are 1.5 times higher than the values obtained for MeA alpha P, and that the ID50 value of IQ is 1.5-2 times higher than those of the other compounds.
the mutagenicity and tumour-initiating activity of the nine pyrolysates were not necessarily correlated.
